title: The best PMS for small short-term rental hosts (1 to 10 units)
summary: Nine PMS options for 1-10 unit hosts compared on published pricing, channels and features, checked on vendor sites in November 2026.
body_markdown:
**For a host with 1 to 10 units, the best PMS is the one with a published price that fits your portfolio, direct connections to the platforms you list on, and the operations features you'll use, not the one built for 500-unit managers. Hospitable, OwnerRez and Lodgify are the strongest fits for most small hosts. Guesty has a small-host plan (Lite, for 1 to 3 listings). Hostaway doesn't publish prices and turns away single-listing hosts. Here's how nine options compare, with prices checked on each vendor's site on November 19, 2026.**


We make ProhostAI, which is not a PMS. ProhostAI connects to most of the PMSs below (including Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Lodgify, Smoobu and Beds24) and adds AI messaging and operations on top. We don't earn anything from which PMS you pick. Prices below are list prices from each official pricing page; several vendors were running Black Friday promotions on the day we checked, which we've left out because they expire.
